{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": [
      "human_approval_required_before_numerical_workflow",
      "no_coverage_or_numerical_outputs_by_llm"
    ]
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve sizing study plan for MISO with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 10.0. Numerical outputs, including reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results, are produced only by the verified numerical workflow and are not generated here. The study requires human approval before computation.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "Region MISO, horizon 120 minutes, and shortfall cost 10.0 are supported. The request asks to prepare the study plan and wait for approval before computation, which is consistent with the auditable workflow. No numerical reserve, cost, coverage, interval, bootstrap, or dispatch outputs are requested or produced by the LLM.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "confirm_human_approval_before_numerical_workflow",
    "construct_rolling_window_with_train_days_730_cal_days_30_test_days_30_step_days_30",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary_and_forbidden_variables",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_to_compute_reserve_cost_coverage_and_uncertainty_outputs",
    "record_audit_log_and_evidence_trace"
  ]
}
